1318 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
255 days before 08-13:  
Back up 8 months to Dec 13 of previous year? Let's count days:  
From 08-13 back to 01-01 of same year: Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) = 31+28=59, +31=90, +30=120, +31=151, +30=181, +31=212 days from Jan 1 to Aug 13? Wait, that's wrong — actually from Jan 1 to Aug 13 is:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, plus 13 days of Aug = 31+28=59, +31=90, +30=120, +31=151, +30=181, +31=212, +13=225 days.  

So Aug 13 is 225 days into the year.  
255 days before Aug 13 means go back 255 days:  
255 - 225 = 30 days before Jan 1 of 1318 → that lands in previous year 1317.  
Days left in 1317 after subtracting 225 days from 255: 30 days before Jan 1, 1318 = Dec 2, 1317 (since Dec has 31 days: Dec 2 + 30 days = Jan 1).  

Check: From Dec 2, 1317 to Jan 1, 1318 = 30 days (Dec 2–31: 30 days inclusive? Let’s count: Dec 2 to Dec 31 = 30 days, then Jan 1 is next day, so 30 days before Jan 1 is Dec 2).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1317-12-02
